thread:
maya: Quick sync: users can't find the 'pin to top' affordance in compact rules view. It reads as decorative.
sam: Proposal: add hover label + persistent tiny 'Pinned' chip when a rule is pinned. Also add tooltip that lists shortcut (Ctrl+Shift+P).
jordan: Agree on tooltip. Also surface the pin in the rule context menu for discoverability.
devin: The simulator control disappears when rules are collapsed. Suggest a sticky micro-simulator in the editor header: play/pause + last-run timestamp.
aria: Accessibility: pin button has no accessible name in compact mode. Add aria-label="Pin rule to top" and aria-pressed semantics.
maya: Also fix tab order so the pin is focusable before the rule body. Improves keyboard flow.
sam: Validation message rewrite: change "Rule conflict" -> "Conflicting rules detected — adjust priorities or pin a rule to resolve." Add a small "Learn how priorities work" link.
jordan: We'll add an inline help link opening a docs modal.
devin: Default simulator behavior should be draft-run. Add a dropdown to switch to 'Last published'. Show a warning for very large policies (>100 rules).
aria: Color contrast: pinned chip fails AA at small sizes. Use darker fill or heavier text.
sam: Preview results table: allow wrap or row expand for the 'explanation' column.
maya: Action items: update prototype with pin visibility + aria fix + sticky micro-simulator + improved validation copy + simulate-draft default.
jordan: I'll update Figma and tag components for dev. ETA EOD.
design-ci-bot: Figma updated: https://figma.com/file/ghi789/routing-editor-v3 frames 30-34 (jordan/maya).
maya: Can someone run keyboard-only/a11y QA on the new frames? Devin?
devin: On it tomorrow, will post findings.
sam: I'll file a small ticket for copy and aria acceptance criteria and link it here. :thumbsup:
